qualification: Diagnostic every-tic nested scope timers: inclusive contains children; exclusive subtracts measured child bodies. Lookup/stack/timer overhead and uninstrumented work remain. PlayerThink entry of player0 defines each interval before WorldTick and Thinkers; HUD samples are assigned to the preceding simulation tic because native level.time increments before drawing. Inherited status-bar Tick is preserved and then timestamped at the end of P_Ticker. RenderUnderlay is after3D rendering; last RenderOverlay bounds the HUD callback phase. Remaining native/frame work is residual, not GPU time. No production performance or universal equivalence claim.
